title: cal audit-pr --json
description: Provenance, per-file history, recurring errors and memory for a pull request.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

repo.description: The repo's project key (worktrees resolve to the main repo).

bySha.description: Per input sha, as given: the threads inferred to have produced it (empty when none).

byFile.description: Per changed file, as given: prior threads that mentioned it, newest first.

recurringErrors.description: The repo's recurring errors over the last 180 days.

projectMemory.description: The repo's decisions, gotchas and open TODOs (null when it can't be read).

overlap.description: Files the thread and the commit share (a confidence proxy, not normalized).

extracted.description: Whether the thread was distilled at all.

stale.description: The thread changed after it was distilled, so its facts predate the latest turns.

AuditKnowledge.description: A thread's distilled reasoning, null when it could not be read.

example.description:
A representative raw error line (the latest raw sighting: candidates are read newest
first and the first line seen for a signature is kept).

count.description: How many messages this error appeared in (≈ times you hit it).

IssueCluster.description: One recurring error, grouped by its normalized signature.

superseded.description: Replaced facts, kept as history (`history` queries only).

flagged.description: Facts with an unresolved stale / wrong flag, pinned ones included (`history` only).

ProjectMemory.description:
Durable, aggregated knowledge for one project: decisions + gotchas + open TODOs
distilled across all its threads, plus coverage so callers can prompt to distill more.

The three lists hold live facts only: never a superseded one, and a flagged one only when
it is pinned (the user's trusted fact stays injected, labelled `flagged`). Disputed facts
stay, labelled. `superseded` and `flagged` are filled only for a [`MemoryQuery`] with
`history` (the Projects page): decisions and gotchas together, by the same order.

edited.description:
The user rewrote its text: curated like a pinned fact, so an unresolved flag leaves it
in memory. With `pinned` it says why a flagged fact is still in memory, which the
Projects page used to infer from the live lists. Left out of the JSON when false.

extractor.description:
Who wrote it: `llm`, `heuristic`, `user`, `agent`, or a harvest origin such as
`claude-memory`. The SessionStart hook and the managed AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md block
drop `claude-memory` facts, which Claude Code already loads from its own auto memory,
and so does `.callimachus/memory.md`, a repo file people commit; MCP results and the
Projects tab keep them. `repo`: imported from the repo's committed
`.callimachus/memory/` files (`originRef` names the file), shown everywhere.

decidedAt.description:
When it was decided (epoch seconds, [`DECIDED_AT_SQL`]): a distilled fact's session
start, else its own time.

source.description:
The source kind of its thread (`claude_code`, `codex`; `in_app` for recorded and
imported facts, which live on the project's "Recorded memory" thread).

replaces.description:
The ids of the facts it actively supersedes, newest first: the same list of fact ids
as `replaces` on a recall or check hit, so the key means one thing on every surface.

replacesDecidedAt.description:
`decidedAt` of the newest fact it actively supersedes (the `replaces <date>` clause in
a memory line). A date, never a fact id: the ids are in `replaces`.

disputedBy.description: The facts it is disputed with (active `contradicts` links), newest first.

support.description: 1 + the other sessions that reaffirmed it.

lastConfirmed.description: The newest start among those sessions.

flags.description: Its unresolved stale / wrong flags (flagged facts only).

MemoryFact.description:
One distilled fact in a project's aggregated memory, with its source thread, when it was
decided and where it stands. The fields after `originRef` are additions (0035): empty and
None ones are left out of the JSON.

FactStatus.description:
Where a fact stands, in priority order: an active `supersedes` link points at it
(`superseded`), an unresolved stale / wrong flag (`flagged`), an active `contradicts` link
on either side whose other fact is still in play, not hidden or superseded (`disputed`),
else `current`.

threadId.description: Its session thread; None for a recorded or imported fact (no session to cite).

LinkedFact.description:
The other side of an active link: the fact that replaced this one, one it replaces, or one
that disputes it.

FactFlag.description: An unresolved stale / wrong flag on a fact.

linksRefreshed.description: Thread-commit links refreshed for the branch before answering.

threadKnowledgeAvailable.description: False when distillation is off: knowledge fields are null, the rest still fills in.
